name: Agent boards
ownerWords:
what is 
- duty
- the 3-hourly nudge

in prime-agent-chat, and in sw-factory? is it differently implemented/different in practice? (why do i feel like sw-factory is lazy) 

시험: what are some core concepts? like all board items should be either user-bottlenecked or actively being worked on.
(#sw-factory-build p205, 11-24, msg mwtu5kfz)
goal: Every open step on every sw factory agent's board is either actively worked on or held on the owner. The precheck (apps/chat/scripts/duties/agent-boards.ts) reads each agent's GET /api/agents/<id>/steps, which counts by the check-in's own rule (server/check-in-job.ts checkInPrecheck): a step is moved while its own job is at work, a subagent of it works or it sleeps on a board.wake, and held while an open For you todo links it by its step field or it waits on the owner's go. It also counts the open goals short of their target that no live job owns, and the check-ins that are not paused and have no run in 1.5 of their intervals. On 11-24 by the owner's rule 7 of 44 open steps had neither a live owner nor an open For you todo, against 2 of 39 on the Prime chats (~/work/duty-and-nudge/part3-lazy.md). It also counts the agents that keep no live duty over their areas, by the owner's ask (#dev-api-portal p27, msg mwwk9n6k, 11-26: "make sure all other agents are well behaved in terms of keeping their responsibilities"; p25: "think of duty as copy pasting this prompt every day"). A duty is live when it is not paused and has a run that measured something. An agent with no live duty is uncovered, and so is an agent with an area in ~/work/agent-duties/areas.json ([{agent, areas: [{area, source, duty}]}]) that names no duty or a duty that is not live. An agent with no brief and no area from the owner in that file (a source of "none found" is a placeholder) has no area: it is left out of the count and listed apart as agents_without_area, as feature probe was on 11-26. On 11-26 at 05:13 KST, 6 of 17 agents had no duty at all.

metrics.label: Open steps on sw factory agents' boards that no job of theirs works on and no open For you todo holds
Open goals short of their target that no live job owns
Agents whose check-in is not paused and has no run in 1.5 of its intervals
Agents with no live duty, or with an area from the areas file that no live duty watches

onMiss: Each flagged step names its agent, its step and why it is stuck. Find why that agent's check-in did not give it an owner: read the agent's newest check-in run in GET /api/agents/<id>/check-in (its summary, detail file and job) and the check-in job's transcript. Fix the cause in the system, such as the check-in brief (apps/chat/server/check-in-job.ts), the board skill text (skills/board) or the server's check-in and push code (apps/chat/server/boards.ts), add a test, push and release; never close or reassign another agent's steps by hand to turn the number green. A step that waits on a time or on another agent's job with no job of its own is stuck by the owner's rule: the fix makes the check-in give it a job that sleeps on a board.wake, link a For you todo, or drop it. A late check-in means its clock did not fire: read the apps/chat log for 'check-in <agent>' lines. Each uncovered_agent item names an agent and the areas no live duty watches. Tell that agent's work thread in one message, with await agent_message.send(text, receiver_role='sibling', receiver_name=<the agent's thread id from GET /api/agents>), to add a daily duty for each named area with legacy/prime/user-history/scripts/duties/add.ts, or to resume or fix a paused or never-run one, and to answer with the duty ids; never add a duty to another agent's board yourself. When the agent's areas have changed, update ~/work/agent-duties/areas.json with the area, its source message id and the duty that watches it.
